abstentions.query: MATCH (n:Technique) WHERE n.attack_id IN $ids OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r]-(m) WITH n, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE type(r) END AS rel, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE startNode(r) = n END AS outgoing, CASE WHEN m IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE head(labels(m)) END AS neighbour_label, count(m) AS cnt WITH n, collect(CASE WHEN rel IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {rel: rel, outgoing: outgoing, label: neighbour_label, count: cnt} END) AS raw WITH n, [f IN raw WHERE f IS NOT NULL] AS facets RETURN n.attack_id AS id, n.name AS name, n.properties_json AS properties_json, facets AS facets LIMIT 20000
